Name: Simple Nightfall
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][color=#D8B4FE][b]🌙 Simple Nightfall[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]💜 If you enjoy my mods, please consider endorsing this mod. Thank you for your support! ⭐[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]This mod is made for PC. Android compatibility has not been tested.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Choose a [b]2–6 AM bedtime[/b] and enjoy more time after dark with the game’s native clock and night lighting. The default cutoff is [b]6 AM[/b].[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]🧪 Version 1.1[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB][b]Single-player only.[/b] Isolated clock, settings and rendering checks have passed. Full live overnight saving and full modpack compatibility remain unverified; test a copied save before regular use.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]🌌 Set Your Bedtime[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]• Pick a pass-out time from [b]2 AM to 6 AM[/b] in [b]10-minute steps[/b].
• Bedtime changes take effect [b]the following day[/b]. Today’s cutoff stays fixed through reloads, including the first day a save uses Nightfall.
• The native clock keeps its timing, pauses and night lighting.
• Bedtime handling moves to your chosen cutoff, avoiding the repeated 2 AM horse dismount. Normal manual dismounting remains available.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#D8B4FE][b]🔔 Reminders & Bedtime Indicator[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Choose reminders [b]60, 30 and/or 10 in-game minutes[/b] before bedtime. Select [b]text and sound, text only, sound only or off[/b]. These replace the fixed midnight/1 AM warnings while Nightfall is active; a time skip produces one reminder with the actual time remaining.

An optional gold indicator shows your bedtime [b]beneath the clock[/b]. It appears only during the final hour by default, or can stay visible throughout the day. Adjust its vertical position if another mod uses that space. It hides during menus, dialogue, events and fades, or when there is insufficient room.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#A7F3D0][b]⚙ Requirements & Settings[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Requires [b]Stardew Valley 1.6[/b] and a compatible [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI 4.x[/url] installation. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is optional and provides the slider and checkboxes.

Extract the chosen edition’s [b]SimpleNightfall[/b] folder into [b]Mods[/b], then launch through SMAPI. Bedtime, reminder and indicator settings can be adjusted in-game through GMCM; [b]Enable Nightfall[/b] is title-screen only. Without GMCM, edit config.json while the game is closed. Cutoff changes still wait until the next day.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]🌙 Compatibility & Gameplay Notes[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]• [b]Multiplayer and split-screen are inactive[/b] in this test release.
• Choose one night extension. Nightfall stays inactive if it detects [b]Night Owl, Night Owl Plus or Beyond Bedtime[/b].
• Native pass-out costs, exhaustion and late-sleep penalties still apply; fish availability rules are unchanged.
• Darker-night mods have not been verified.
• [b]nightfall_status[/b] in the SMAPI console reports today’s cutoff, the next-day setting and Nightfall’s status without changing the game.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]📱 Experimental Android Edition[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]The separate Android test build has the same settings and reserves space for native touch controls beneath the clock. It requires a compatible [b]Android SMAPI 4.x[/b] setup. Android 1.6.15.3 code and desktop fixtures were checked; on-device startup, touch, graphics and overnight saving remain [b]untested[/b]. Choose the PC [b]or[/b] Android edition, never both.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]🐛 Bug Reports & 💡 Suggestions[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Please share reports and ideas here on this mod’s page.

[b]For bugs:[/b] include the Nightfall version and edition; game/SMAPI versions and platform; what happened versus what you expected; steps to reproduce; a [url=https://smapi.io/log]shared SMAPI log link[/url]; and a screenshot or short video if helpful.

[b]For suggestions:[/b] tell me what you would like changed or added and how it would improve the mod.[/color][/size][/center]
